behaviors.description: Observe build initialization diagnostics with known runtime inputs.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent installed runtime and fresh build output for every invocation.
behaviors.expected: Flagged invocations add diagnostic lines between stable quiet controls while retaining expected build metadata.

behaviors.description: Observe build finalization diagnostics on recreated independent inputs.
behaviors.preconditions: An unfinalized copy of the independently prepared build tree for every invocation.
behaviors.expected: Flagged invocations add diagnostic lines between stable quiet controls while producing the export directory and expected app metadata.

behaviors.description: Observe build export diagnostics with fixed timestamps and independent metadata.
behaviors.preconditions: The same independently finalized app tree and fresh repository for each invocation.
behaviors.expected: Flagged invocations add diagnostics while all exports preserve independent metadata and pass repository integrity checks.

behaviors.description: Observe bundle diagnostics while independently importing each output.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A repository and fresh output paths.
behaviors.expected: Flagged invocations add diagnostics; independent OSTree offline application of every bundle yields the known app commit.

behaviors.description: Observe bundle import diagnostics with independent commit oracles.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A bundle and fresh empty repositories.
behaviors.expected: Flagged invocations add diagnostics; every imported repository resolves the exact independent app commit and passes integrity checks.

behaviors.description: Observe commit promotion diagnostics on immutable independent source content.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A source, fixed timestamps and fresh destination repositories.
behaviors.expected: Flagged invocations add diagnostics while all destinations retain independent metadata and pass integrity checks.

behaviors.description: Observe signing diagnostics while verifying each signature independently.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app commit, disposable signing key and fresh unsigned repository copies.
behaviors.expected: Flagged invocations add diagnostics while preserving the exact app commit and producing signatures verified by the independent public key.

behaviors.description: Observe repository update diagnostics with independently prepared app commits.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh copies of the independent A repository.
behaviors.expected: Flagged invocations add diagnostics between stable quiet controls while preserving app commits and repository integrity.
